svg.title: Tokens to answer about 44 real documents
svg.desc: 27 PDF guides, 7 Word designs and 10 Excel workbooks. Reading them whole: 27.8 M tokens, $111.08 with Claude Opus 5.5. With DocPack, a first question on each: 166,725 tokens (99.4% less). Each following question: 23,368 tokens (99.9% less). Median per document: 94.9% and 99.6% less.
svg.text: Tokens to answer about 44 real documents
27 PDF guides (up to 3,220 pages), 7 Word designs and 10 Excel workbooks · one question each
Median per document: 94.9% less on the 1st question and 99.6% on the next ones.
6 of the 44 are over a million tokens: without DocPack they do not fit in a conversation.
Claude Opus 5.5 input price ($4 per million) · log scale · local conversion: 0 tokens
